title: No Joy 7"
about: A two-track 7-inch featuring No Summer and No Joy. Recorded, mixed and mastered by Graham Van Pelt at The Pines Studio in Montreal.

title: Sunglasses EP
about: A five-song EP issued on 12-inch by Divorce Records. Engineering by Graham Van Pelt, with recording credits shared with David Bryant.

title: Subterranean Megazit
about: Originally released on cassette in 2009. Choke was recorded by Graham Van Pelt, credited as ‘Graeme Van Pelt’; the other three songs were recorded by Dead Wife. The player presents the 2015 digital edition.

title: Sing That Yell That Spell
about: The trio's self-titled five-track CD (EGR003). Discogs lists Graham Van Pelt for engineering, mixing and mastering, and production alongside the band.

title: National Parks Project
about: A collaborative soundtrack recorded in Canada's national parks. The double-vinyl credits on Discogs list Graham Van Pelt on vocals for Kathleen Lake, alongside Ian D’Sa on guitar and Mishka Stein on bass and finger cymbals. This entry represents the 26-track double LP.

title: Free Dimensional
about: Diamond Rings' second album. Discogs credits Graham Van Pelt with guitar on Hand Over My Heart, track 6.

title: Show Me Your Stuff
credit: Remix as Miracle Fortress — You Oughta Know (B2)
about: The four-track 12-inch (OBS12-001), featuring You Oughta Know (Miracle Fortress Remix) on B2, as listed on Discogs. This remix is not included on the current two-track digital edition.

title: Fallen Empires
credit: Remix as Miracle Fortress — Called Out in the Dark (track 15)
about: The Japanese CD edition (UICP-1131), featuring Called Out in the Dark (Miracle Fortress Remix) as bonus track 15. Released November 16, 2011.

title: New Found Land
about: New Found Land's self-titled album includes a recording of Everything Works, written by Graham Van Pelt / Miracle Fortress, as track 3. Graham's contribution is songwriting, rather than performance on this recording.
